senses.definition: used as cord or line Jb 40:26 (of twisted rushes, or spun of rush-fibre, cf. Di ad loc.); as fuel 41:12; sim. of bending head Is 58:5.
metaph. of the lowly, insignif. (‖ כִּפָּה) Is 9:13; 19:15.
